title: ERC orders Meralco to refund P1.99 billion to consumers
summary: The Energy Regulatory Commission (ERC) has ordered Meralco to refund P1.99 billion to customers after revaluing its regulatory asset base and disallowing certain pension and employee benefit expenses.
